label: human
scenario: Heavily scripted call-center human: formulaic verification and closing lines, repeats 'anything else' verbatim, short silent lookup pause; gives claim status from the record.
task: Find out the status of the policyholder's auto insurance claim filed August 28th.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Bellwether Mutual Insurance, my name is Gregory, may I have your policy number please?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi Gregory. I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a policyholder, Anika Sorensen. Her policy number is B M 4 4 0 7 2 9 1 5.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you. For verification purposes, may I please have the policyholder's date of birth and the ZIP code on the policy?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Her date of birth is March 3rd, 1986, and the ZIP code is 0 2 7 4 1.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for that information. Before we proceed, I do need to let you know that since you are calling on behalf of the policyholder, I am able to provide claim status information only, and I will not be able to make any changes to the policy. Is that understood?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, understood. We'd like the status of her auto claim filed on August 28th.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you. One moment while I pull up that claim.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. I show claim number C L 7 7 3 0 5 8 for a rear-end collision on August 27th. The claim was approved on September 9th. A payment in the amount of two thousand, three hundred forty dollars and sixty cents was issued to Harborview Auto Body on September 11th.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Thank you. So the claim is approved, and payment of $2,340.60 went directly to Harborview Auto Body on September 11th?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That is correct. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Is there any remaining deductible she owes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Per the claim record, the five hundred dollar deductible was applied to the payment, and the policyholder would pay that directly to the repair facility. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Bellwether Mutual Insurance. You may receive a brief survey about your experience today. Have a wonderful day.
